name: Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences
overview:
Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences is a large vocational university located in Amsterdam, Netherlands. The AUAS offers bachelor programmes, and a number of (professional) master programmes. For students from the AUAS' international partner institutes it is possible to study at the AUAS as an exchange student.

The AUAS offers eighty courses of study, spread across locations in Amsterdam. The university maintains ties with the University of Amsterdam. The 2,300 employees of the AUAS serve more than 40,000 students.
administrative:
1) Application dossier

  • Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application.
  • All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).
  • If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.

To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.


2) Visa

  • For European students, a valid passport/ national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK).
  • For non-Europeans students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees.
  • Students in France can use this website as well: https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


3) Insurance

  • For European students:
  • The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM in French) is nominative and individual. This card certifies your rights to the Health Insurance in Europe.
  • To obtain your card, log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure. It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks. You can also download it online.
  • For more information: https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger
  • For non-European students:
  • You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay. Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.


Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country for French citizens only:

https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html

courses:
30 ECTS per semester

60 ECTS a year


Students will follow courses from the Information Technology and Computer Science faculty. Students can choose one programme only per semester and are not allowed to mix courses from different programmes.

  • Applied Quantum Computing
  • Data Driven Business
  • Gameplay Engineering
  • Global Trendwatching
  • Immersive Tech
  • Impact Apps
  • Makers Lab: Making as Research
  • Smart Cities
  • Sustainable Futures: Nature + Design + Creativity
  • Urban Interaction Design



The course list is given to you for information. It can change from year to year. If a course is not available when you arrive, EPITECH cannot be held responsible for it.
